literal: Words that do not deviate from courtesy, yielding benefit, will yield pleasantness and produce virtue.
translation: Words that do not deviate from courtesy, while yielding fruitful benefits, will produce pleasantness and yield lasting virtue.
modern: நற்பண்பிலிருந்து விலகாமல், நன்மையைத் தந்து, இன்பத்தையும் அறத்தையும் தருவது இனிய சொற்கள் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the profound impact of speaking sweet words that are rooted in good character. Words that do not deviate from courtesy and bring practical benefit have a dual effect. They produce immediate pleasantness or harmony and yield long-term moral virtue. Thus, true sweet speech is not mere flattery, but a virtuous act that benefits both the speaker and the listener.
